title: 第30章
content:
徐老不悦说罢，忙拿出自己的银针，手速飞快的扎在几个穴位之上。银针在他的手中变得活灵活现，随着他的手转动。可明明平时看他治病救人都游刃有余，但这一刻，他却罕见的皱了眉，甚至鬓角也流下冷汗！周围人见状大气都不敢喘。“怎么样？”冷希深呼吸一口气，问道。徐老陡然松了手，长长的喘了一口气，眼中满是遗憾。“不行了，气急攻心，血液逆流，救不回来了，你们准备后事吧。”“什么？！”一句准备后事，让这群人全都傻了眼！“不可能，爷爷刚刚还好好的，怎么会转眼间就要……”冷希声音颤抖，话都说不下去了，身子颤栗个不停。冷晓月冷哼：“都是你们害的！”“啪——！”冷希一巴掌干脆果断的扇了上去，她眼里满是盛腾的怒气。“冷晓月，你的良心是被狗吃了吗？都什么时候了，你还顾着是谁害的？爷爷到底是被谁所气，你心里不清楚吗？”冷希眼眸含泪，眼眶湿润。就连徐老都说不行，那即便是她相信明川，怕是也……没成想，爷爷的七十大寿，居然会演到如此地步！“我……”冷晓月还想说点什么为自己辩解。可看着冷希眼神里闪烁的浓烈寒意，她下意识的后退了一步，躲在孙韶华身后，不敢再说话了。见状，就连明川都不由得有几分动容。要知道，从他见到冷希起，她就一直是冷傲坚毅的形象，还从有过像现在这般彻底破防的样子！徐老爷子摇头站起身，“抱歉大小姐，老朽尽力了。”“怎么会……”孙韶华脸烧红。而就在所有人都沉浸在老爷子即将不行的消息中时，明川淡然的越过所有人的视线，直接站在了老爷子的身前，抬手，迅速地将老爷子身上的几根银针调换了位置。手指捻动着银针顶部，让整个针尖都跟着颤抖。几个穴位中猛然溢出几分黑气！再一眨眼，徐老包里又消失了几根银针，转瞬到了明川手中，宛若游龙，轻盈游走在老爷子身体周身，朝着皮下穴位斜刺下去！下一刻，冷老爷子深呼吸一口气，睁开了双眼！明川见状，嘴角勾笑，用手在他的心口穴位按下几下，原本冷冽的四肢逐渐回温。老爷子涣散的瞳孔也渐渐有了神！“啊……”他轻呼一声，难受得眉头紧拧，心脏处传来的绞痛感让他身体痉挛。可片刻后，那绞痛消失，取而代之的，是一种从未有过的舒适！“我……我这是怎么了？！”老爷子不可置信的看着自己的身体反应。就在他刚才昏过去的那几分钟里，他能清晰的听见周围所有人的动静。包括明川刚才动针灸！而自从明川动了针灸之后，他心口堵塞的气体好似被肉散，丹田处也不断有暖气朝着四肢输送。短短几秒钟的时间，他原本紧绷得不能动弹的肌肉，松弛了下来！天，世间怎会有如此神奇的事！

也就只有明川才能做得到了！周遭人听见老爷子的声音，都诧异的朝着他看来，见他睁开眼迷茫的看向四周的模样，冷希激动的扑上去。“爷爷，您醒了？！”“您感觉怎么样？身体好受了一些吗？”冷晓月不屑的跺脚：“姐，你刚才还打我。现在你可看到了，爷爷全都是靠孙韶华叫来的徐神医治好的！”“我都说了，韶华只是一时的经济危机，他可不……”“闭嘴！”老爷子出声喝止。他眼神冷冰冰的朝着冷晓月看了过去。“冷晓月，你不分好歹，只在意这孙家小子。”“刚才徐老已经说得很清楚了，他无能为力！要不是明川救了我，恐怕，你根本就没有机会在此说这些冠冕堂皇的话！”要不是这冷家几人先前只顾着吵架闹事，明川怎能越过他们直接替老爷子医治？“这……怎么会……”冷晓月瞪大眼。孙韶华也不服气道：“老爷子，徐老的实力可是有目共睹的，怎么可能是这乡巴佬救了你？”“滚！都给我滚出去！”冷老爷子怒目圆睁，身子抖动得厉害：“冷晓月，若你不断绝与孙家此子的联系，自今日起，你这辈子都别想继承冷家家产！”“什么？！”冷晓月如雷轰顶，“爷爷，不就是一点小摩擦，你……”“什么小摩擦！”冷老爷子面黑道，“你们肆意侮辱我的孙婿，还毁了我的七十大寿。孙韶华还借了两个亿的高利贷！你愿意跳这火坑，你自己去跳吧！”“带上孙韶华，给我滚出冷家！”“爷爷！”冷晓月不甘心，咬着唇朝他喊。任晓兰也身子僵硬在原地，尬笑两声道：“老爷子，这没有必要吧……是不是做得有点过了？”冷老爷子一记眼刀，任晓兰立马闭上了眼。留得青山在不愁没柴烧，要是她也一起被赶出了冷家，哪里还能有她们母女二人的留身地？冷晓月跺了跺脚，气得不行，又不敢再说话，只能愤愤的一甩手，抓着孙韶华就匆匆离开了冷家。就在二人离开冷家的最后一秒，孙韶华回头看了一眼明川。他那双眼里，是藏不住的恨意。都是这人，打乱了他今天的所有计划！让他接二连三被打脸！“明川是吧，我记住你了。”明川无所谓的一耸肩，“记住也没用啊，出去吃饭报爷大名也没有折扣。”死不要脸！孙韶华气急败坏。一时间，整个大厅都变得安静了下来，气氛无比诡异。徐老神医见这场面，也不好再多待下去，只能拱手朝着众人行了个礼，便也跟着退了出去。……见着整个大厅安宁下来，冷老爷子这才长长的舒了一口气，心里都要好受了些许。他看向边上的冷希跟明川二人，郑重的拍了拍两人的手。又将他们的手拉到一起，眼里泛着欣慰的泪花。“小希啊，明川是个值得托付终身的人，你可一定要好好珍惜，千万别弄丢了他。”“明日，你们两人就去领证吧。”
content_en:
Mr. Xu said displeasedly and quickly took out his silver needle and quickly inserted it into several acupuncture points.The silver needle became vivid in his hand, turning with his hand.But usually he could treat illnesses and save people with ease, but at this moment, he frowned in a rare way, and even had cold sweat streaming from his temples!The people around him didn't dare to breathe when they saw this."How is it?" Leng hope took a deep breath and asked.Mr. Xu suddenly let go of his hand and took a long breath, his eyes full of regret."It's not going to work anymore. I'm so angry that my blood is flowing backwards. I can't save him. You should prepare for the funeral." "What?!" "Preparing for the funeral" made everyone in this group dumbfounded!"Impossible, grandpa was fine just now, how could he suddenly..." Leng hope's voice trembled, and she could no longer speak, and her body was shaking non-stop.Leng Xiaoyue snorted coldly: "It's all your fault!" "Pah!" Leng Xi slapped her decisively, her eyes full of anger."Leng Xiaoyue, was your conscience eaten by a dog? How long has it been, and you still care about who did it? Don't you know who was angered by grandpa?" Leng hope's eyes were filled with tears, and his eyes were moist.Even Mr. Xu said no, so even if she believed in Mingchuan, she would still... I never imagined that grandpa's seventieth birthday would actually go to such an extent!"I..." Leng Xiaoyue still wanted to say something to defend herself.But seeing the strong chill in Leng hope's eyes, she subconsciously took a step back and hid behind Sun Shaohua, not daring to speak any more.Seeing this, even Mingchuan couldn't help but feel a little moved.You know, ever since he met Leng hope, she has always been a cold, arrogant and resolute image, and she has never looked so completely broken like now!Mr. Xu shook his head and stood up, "I'm sorry, Miss, I tried my best." "How could it be..." Sun Shaohua's face turned red.And just when everyone was immersed in the news that the old man was about to die, Mingchuan calmly crossed everyone's line of sight and stood directly in front of the old man. He raised his hand and quickly changed the positions of several silver needles on the old man's body.His fingers twisted the top of the silver needle, making the entire needle tip tremble.A bit of black energy suddenly overflowed from several acupuncture points!In the blink of an eye, a few more silver needles disappeared from Mr. Xu's bag, and in an instant they were in Mingchuan's hands. Like a dragon, they moved lightly around the old man's body and stabbed diagonally towards the acupuncture points under the skin!The next moment, Mr. Leng took a deep breath and opened his eyes!Seeing this, Mingchuan smiled and pressed his hands on the acupuncture points on his heart a few times. His originally cold limbs gradually warmed up.The old man's dilated pupils gradually regained consciousness!"Ah..." He breathed softly, his brows furrowed in discomfort, and the cramping feeling from his heart made his body convulse.But after a while, the cramping pain disappeared and was replaced by a kind of comfort that I had never felt before!"I...what's wrong with me?!" The old man looked at his body's reaction in disbelief.In the few minutes he had just passed out, he could clearly hear the movements of everyone around him.Including Mingchuan just had acupuncture!And since Mingchuan had acupuncture, the air blocked in his heart seemed to be dispersed by the flesh, and warm air was constantly flowing from his Dantian towards his limbs.In just a few seconds, his muscles, which were so tight that he could not move, relaxed!God, how could there be such a magical thing in the world!

Only Mingchuan can do it!People around him heard the old man's voice and looked at him in surprise. Seeing him opening his eyes and looking around in confusion, Leng hope rushed towards him excitedly."Grandpa, are you awake?!" "How do you feel? Are you feeling better?" Leng Xiaoyue stomped her feet disdainfully: "Sister, you hit me just now. Now you can see that grandpa was all cured by Dr. Xu called by Sun Shaohua!" "I told you, Shaohua was just a temporary economic crisis, he didn't..." "Shut up!" The old man shouted to stop.He looked towards Leng Xiaoyue with cold eyes."Leng Xiaoyue, you don't distinguish between good and evil, you only care about this boy from the Sun family." "Mr. Xu has made it very clear just now that there is nothing he can do! If Mingchuan hadn't saved me, I'm afraid you wouldn't have had the chance to say these high-sounding words here!" If the Leng family hadn't been focused on quarreling and making trouble, how could Mingchuan bypass them and directly treat the old man?"How...how could this happen..." Leng Xiaoyue's eyes widened.Sun Shaohua was not convinced and said: "Old man, Mr. Xu's strength is obvious to all. How could this country bumpkin save you?" "Get out! Get out of here!" Mr. Leng's eyes widened with anger and his body was shaking violently: "Leng Xiaoyue, if you don't cut off contact with this son of the Sun family, from today on, you will never be able to inherit the Leng family's property!" "What?!" Leng Xiaoyue thundered.Top, "Grandpa, it's just a little friction, you..." "What a little friction!" Mr. Leng said with a black face, "You wantonly insulted my grandson-in-law and ruined my seventieth birthday. Sun Shaohua also borrowed 200 million in loan sharks! If you are willing to jump into this pit, you can jump yourself!" "Take Sun Shaohua and get out of the Leng family!" "Grandpa!" Leng Xiaoyue was unwilling to bite her lip and shouted at him.Ren Xiaolan also froze in place, laughed awkwardly and said: "Old man, this is not necessary...is it a bit too much?" Mr. Leng struck a knife in the eye, and Ren Xiaolan immediately closed her eyes.There was no need to worry about having no firewood for the green hills left. If she was also kicked out of the Leng family, where would there be a place for mother and daughter to stay?Leng Xiaoyue stamped her feet. She was so angry that she didn't dare to speak anymore. She could only wave her hands angrily, grab Sun Shaohua and leave the Leng family in a hurry.At the last second when the two left the Leng family, Sun Shaohua looked back at Mingchuan.There was unconcealable hatred in his eyes.It was this person who disrupted all his plans for today!Let him be slapped in the face one after another!"Mingchuan, right? I remember you." Mingchuan shrugged nonchalantly, "It's useless to remember. There's no discount for saying your name when you go out to eat." Shameless!Sun Shaohua was furious.For a moment, the entire hall became quiet, and the atmosphere was extremely strange.Seeing this scene, Old Divine Doctor Xu couldn't stay any longer, so he could only bow his hands to everyone and then retreated....Seeing that the entire hall was peaceful, Mr. Leng let out a long sigh of relief and felt a little better.He looked at Leng hope and Mingchuan beside him, and patted their hands solemnly.He pulled their hands together again, with tears of joy in his eyes."Xiao Xi, Mingchuan is a person worth trusting for life. You must cherish him and never lose him." "Tomorrow, you two will go get the certificate."
